description: Defines the ExponentialBiased class, a small, fast, thread-compatible random number generator for exponential distributions, used for stride-based sampling and event skipping in profiling scenarios.

classes.name: ExponentialBiased
classes.description: A class providing methods for generating random skip counts and strides based on an exponential distribution, optimized for minimal state and synchronization overhead.

methods.name: GetSkipCount
methods.description: Returns the number of events to skip before an event with a given mean probability occurs.

methods.name: GetStride
methods.description: Returns the number of events required for a specific event to happen, related to GetSkipCount.

methods.name: NextRandom
methods.description: Generates a pseudo-random number in a specified range, used internally and for testing.
